testResults.name: focused-ensure-and-coverage-tests
testResults.command: uv run --extra dev pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/lake/http/routes/test_ensure.py tests/lake/coverage tests/lakeclient
testResults.result: 46 passed including two new route tests: re-ensuring a spec whose job record is terminal while coverage has non-terminal sessions supersedes the record, relaunches with the error gap, and clears the stale error_message; an in-flight QUEUED or RUNNING record still short-circuits without relaunching

testResults.name: lint-and-type-gates
testResults.command: uv run --extra dev ruff check src/lake/coverage/application.py src/lakeclient/client.py scripts/soak/run_soak.py tests/lake/http/routes/test_ensure.py && uv run --extra dev ruff format --check ... && uv run --extra dev ty check ...
testResults.result: ruff check, ruff format --check, and ty clean on all four touched paths

testResults.name: incident-repair-context
testResults.result: The 233 SPY trade sessions errored during the 2026-09-06 key-rotation revision rollout (AlpacaHTTPError HTTP 401 recorded in coverage error_message) were repaired ahead of this change via a different-spec range ensure; post-repair coverage shows all 252 sessions in the band complete with row_count 1000 and no residual errors

limitations: The ensure supersede behavior reaches the live soak path only after the API Container App deploy of commit 7f71329; the driver recheck change applies on the next soak launch
The option ensure route (_ensure_option) retains its own short-circuit and is not repaired by this change
